A stainless steel railing is visible beyond the pool. Low evergreen boxwood shrubs and architectural grass plants frame the foreground at the pillar base. The sky and ambient tone is a deep evening blue, making the warm amber glow from the pillar cap the dominant warmth in the frame. The mood is luxurious, serene, and quietly dramatic — a poolside resort-quality garden at night. Camera is at seated-to-low height, looking up slightly at the pillar with a normal-to-slight telephoto lens, framing the cap and its warm glow in clear focus against the soft blue background.
